- *(model-serving)* Verify model and runtime image signatures at admission — modelServing.imageVerification renders a Kyverno verifyImages ClusterPolicy over every model pod of the serving namespace, one rule per pod shape, guards, mirrored in the meta chart in [#557](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/557) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
